notes: Ludum Dare 57 entry titled Selective Drilling. Complete Unity 6 (6000.0.42f1) 2D game (Assets+ProjectSettings+Packages) with Main plus three ending scenes; player drill, enemies, shop, and author-made sprites, tiles, and original audio. MIT. Official Unity packages only (Cinemachine, 2D, Input System, URP, uGUI, Visual Scripting). Bundled Galmuri 11 / Galmuri Mono 11 fonts are SIL Open Font License 1.1 (copyright Minseo Lee / Quiple, declared in the font name tables). No FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no DOTween, no EmojiOne, no Asset Store packages, no LFS. ~22M src snapshot.
